create_stt_singleton: create a singleton STTModelServer instance using STTModelServer.instance() for speech-to-text transcription
feed_audio_chunk: feed a numpy audio chunk to the STTModelServer recorder for real-time transcription
wait_for_transcription: wait for and retrieve a transcription piece from the STTModelServer with an optional callback
use_stt_context_manager: use STTModelServer as a context manager to auto-shutdown the recorder on exit
initialize_stt_recorder: initialize an AudioToTextRecorder with medium model and custom silence duration settings
